messages:
ria: Proposal 1: add an 'Export Observability' card in Console showing recent export jobs, a compact heatmap (tenant x route), and a signed manifest link for each bundle so auditors can verify payloads. Thoughts on routing, quotas, and what telemetry we need?

ben: Love the card. For manifests: store a small manifest artifact in exports DB, sign it with a rotation-aware key, and include manifest_id in the job. That avoids embedding heavy metadata in responses.

anya: Important: the heatmap must not reveal PII. Use hashed tenant ids, aggregated counts, and an opt-in toggle to view full tenant names (admins only). Also show redaction status per job (none/trim/strict).

kevin: Routing: heavy exports should be routable to Dedicated pool when the tenant has reserved capacity. Otherwise run on hosted batch workers with priority queues. If backlog, return job.status=queued + ETA instead of blocking the UI.

ben: Quotas: tenant daily export rows limit, per-tenant concurrent export slots, and global export egress throttle. Also add a cheap preflight API that returns estimated row_count and egress bytes so users see cost before generating. Preflight should be rate-limited but not charged the full quota.

deploy-bot: deploy: export-signing-service v1 canary at 2024-11-05T02:00:00Z :rocket:

ria: Manifest sketch: {bundle_id, generated_at, files:[{path, sha256}], record_count, redaction_level, signer_id}. Sign the manifest and publish signature alongside manifest_id. Console shows 'verify' badge that links to the signature + pk info.

anya: Telemetry: emit export_job_id, preflight_estimate_rows, actual_rows, presigned_ttl, signer_id, and redaction_level. Push to traces and billing. Feature-flag telemetry rollout.

kevin: UX: allow users to request an inline sample (first 50 rows) that respects redaction. Sample should not count against heavy export quota but should be rate-limited per org.

ria: Action items: @kevin add routing rules + queue behavior doc, @ben add manifest signing prototype and key-rotation plan, @anya mock Console card with heatmap (hashed ids + redaction col), I'll draft RFC and schedule a 30m sync.
